Subject: Re: [opensuse] Kmail, extensive disk i/o at startup (10.3)

On Wednesday 13 February 2008, Verner Kjærsgaard said:
> - I'm on SuSE10.3 (plain vanilla, new install) with Kmail 1.9.6 (enterprise
> 20070904.708012) Under KDE 3.5.7 release 72.6.
>
> - I've noticed that when I fire up my DELL Precision M90, Kmail goes amok
> with very heavy kio_file actions. This goes on for about 5 minutes, then
> suddenly it's quiete again - and my PC becomes fully responsive.
>
> I've got something like 100.000+ mails (in total) in my Kmail dirs. Under
> SuSE10.2, this did not happen.
>
> Anything I can do?

You could see if it's beagle indexing your mail - but I don't think this uses 
kio_file to do so.

KDE 3.5.9 will be released with many kdepim fixes next week, please use the 
KDE:KDE3 build service repo to try those packages (of course, back up your 
mail first!)

Will
